AURORA_API_KEY.title: AURORA_API_KEY
AURORA_API_KEY.description: API key or username to used

AURORA_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: AURORA_POLLING_INTERVAL
AURORA_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

AURORA_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: AURORA_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
AURORA_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60)

AURORA_TTL.title: AURORA_TTL
AURORA_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 300)
